A rectangle has a length that is 24 times its width. The function y = (24w)(w) represents this situation, where y is the area, in square feet, of the rectangle and w > 0. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 24w in this context?

options.A: The length of the rectangle, in feet
options.B: The area of the rectangle, in square feet
options.C: The difference between the length and the width of the rectangle, in feet
options.D: The width of the rectangle, in feet

text: The function f(x) = 1,300(0.5)^{\frac{x}{14}} models the intensity of a beam, f(x), in number of photons, x millimeters below the surface of a certain material. According to the model, what is the number of photons in the beam when it is at the surface of the material?

options.C: The measure of angle F and the measure of angle T
